def piece_bbox(L):
    cont={(r,c) for r in range(34,44) for c in range(27,37)}
    cells=[]
    for r in range(9,63):
        for c in range(18,64):
            if L[r][c] not in ('B',) and (r,c) not in cont:
                cells.append((r,c))
    # exclude HUD rows 0-8 already by r>=9; exclude bottom strip row63
    if not cells: return None
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    return (len(cells),min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
L=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print('before:',piece_bbox(L))
action(['UP'])
